text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
drawing near, Air Groove's mother comes to 
pay a visit to Air Groove and her Trainer.

She was worried about whether the stiff, 
formal Air Groove was truly enjoying her 
days.

However, seeing that she had built a 
relationship of trust with her Trainer 
brought a sigh of relief.

Having enjoyed a brief but wonderful time 
with the mother she respected so deeply, 
Air Groove saw her off on her way home.
